notes.title: 1st Anniversary Update
notes.content:
Thanks for playing. It’s been a year since the game was published, and I watched many streams and played with many people who streamed my game. I am glad that I can spread joy to you all. I want this game to spread more fun around the world, so the game will stay free.
This update mainly concerns multiplay. Three new mini-games and a cute new character have been added to the game. If you don’t know how to play this game, you can watch my gameplay videos to get some movement ideas. I hope this game can give you and your friends more hilarious memories.

Updates:
1. 6036 (Minigame)
2. Air Hockey (Minigame)
3. Seesaw (Minigame)
4. Child Stool (New chair)
5. Leisure Chair (Movement improve)
6. Keyboard Controls Changing
7. Player Limit (10 → 16)
8. New Achievement (One Million)

Have fun!

notes.title: Medium Update (Chinese and Japanese Version)
notes.content:
The game is now supporting Chinese (both Simplified and Traditional) and Japanese. Translating is a long journey, and slowly more languages will be added.

Fixed bugs and changes:
- Misalignment of moving platforms
- Bench in Multiplayer
- Timer on go when pausing
- Large stoneball is added in Free Play
- New Languages
- Invert X and invert Y settings for the camera
- Messages shown in the levels
- Game rules of multiplayer games listing

notes.title: Small Update (Leaderboard)
notes.content:
Leaderboard is alive!!!
I think we all want to know how well the other's chairs run. Therefore I have added the leaderboard into the game, the top 500 of each level, total time, and 15m race are applied. Here is the link.
https://steamcommunity.com//stats/2575060/leaderboards/12167942


I have also made a gameplay video and published it on Steam and YouTube. I hope it helps you find some way to run the chair faster. Here is the link.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T9TwEjB9Zd4

Changes about this update:
- Leaderboard system
- Leisure chair adjust
- Improve detection of the finish area
- Camera small adjust (again)

What is coming:
- The chairs are learning some different languages

tags.bug: - Improve detection of the finish area

notes.title: Tiny update about the camera
notes.content:
I have received some feedback about the camera control. The camera is designed to be moving automatically but seems that it is not working very well. The new one should be better now.

Update content:
- Camera control
- Camera moving speed
- Mouse confining

notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
It is time to update the progress of the development. The game is about 85% ready for version 1.0.0. What is left now are music, sound, and user settings. All game systems work and run normally in my first test.

The game should be published as scheduled this month. The actual day will be determined after a few days. I hope it is fun for you and there will not be so many bugs.

Some screenshots are added to the store page to show more details of the game.

Finally, thank you for following the game.
